description: bzip2 1.0.8 (release tarball, sha256-pinned, fetched into tests/tools) built by hcc. src/<f>.c: hcc compiles one file, linked with gcc -O0 objects of the rest; the upstream `make test` (sample1-3) must hold. make-test/*: the same steps with an entirely hcc-built bzip2. level/<in>-<l>: compressed bytes must equal the gcc build's and round-trip. mode/*: command-line modes on files. Driver: tests/drivers/bzip2.py
